nonblocking_findings.defect: The delivered sizes are correct, but a phone card still renders wider than its 520 px source at wide viewports. The section wrapper at page.tsx:358 carries container max-w-6xl px-4 sm:px-6, yet the unlayered .container rule at globals.css:167-169 sets max-width 80rem and padding-inline 1rem and sits outside the @layer utilities block (built CSS 3y0lyxyiqzjmp.css: layer utilities spans bytes 13037-155295, custom .container starts at 157091), so it wins over max-w-6xl and sm:px-6. The phone image then measures 576 CSS px at a 1280 px viewport against a 520 px source, and it first exceeds the source at 1169 px. ProductPicture's shared sizes hint (min-width: 1024px) 25vw, 100vw declares 320 px at 1280, so the browser fetches a smaller variant than the slot. The wide card stays at 1216 px under its 1440 px source and never upscales. The strategy records this as residual risk 3, and plan task 2.5 checks that the three screens are sharp at 1280 px.
